why_this_method.value: Single-point models suggested a higher gas/dust ratio and carbon content, so full-disk thermo-chemical codes were used

evidence.quote: After our results from the modeling suggested a higher gas/dust ratio and carbon content, we turned to more comprehensive thermo-chemical codes which model the thermal physics and chemical evolution throughout the whole disk.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Carbon excess from CO destruction disfavoured because it supplies equal carbon and oxygen

evidence.quote: Additionally, CO destruction would supply equal amounts of carbon and oxygen, while we seek to enhance carbon over oxygen.

limitations_admitted.value: Dust mass, grain size and size distribution are degenerate, giving dust-mass uncertainty of at least a factor of 10

evidence.quote: The total population mass, grain size, and how the grain sizes are distributed are strongly degenerate and can result in uncertainties of the dust mass by a factor of at least 10.

limitations_admitted.value: MRI prediction not yet compared against low observed turbulence

referee_caveats_inferred: Small-dust depletion factor and C/O were tuned to match profiles and are not fitted with uncertainties or a stated goodness-of-fit
Model is mostly compared by eye ('roughly reproduces') to radial profiles of two disks
Herbig versus T Tauri stellar UV differences are confounded with disk age
Alternative explanations (e.g. grain-surface chemistry parameters) were not quantitatively explored
